title: LawSites – Intapp Makes Celeste Generally Available, Calling It An ‘AI Coworker’ To Run the Business Side of Law Firms
summary: Journalist and lawyer Bob Ambrogi published an article on the general availability of Intapp Celeste, an agentic AI coworker built to run the business side […]
body_markdown:
Journalist and lawyer Bob Ambrogi published an article on the general availability of Intapp Celeste, an agentic AI coworker built to run the business side of a firm — from deal screening and conflicts clearance to business development and lateral hiring. His article covers how Celeste executes multi-step workflows as playbooks, operates within a firm’s own ethical walls and audit requirements, and draws on the firm’s systems of record, along with early feedback from adopters including BakerHostetler and Hg.


LawSites – July 16, 2026
